say:0:1630734001:0.text: Did you hear? Merlin's back in the Lyceum.
say:0:1630734001:0.source_cn: 你听说了吗？梅林回莱希拉姆了
say:0:1630734001:0.male: Did you hear? Merlin's back in the Lyceum.
say:0:1630734001:0.female: Did you hear? Merlin's back in the Lyceum.

say:2:1630734003:0.text: Students are running after him like maniacs. It's absurd!
say:2:1630734003:0.source_cn: 一大群学生追着梅林跑，整个学校都快乱套了！
say:2:1630734003:0.male: Students are running after him like maniacs. It's absurd!
say:2:1630734003:0.female: Students are running after her like maniacs. It's absurd!

say:3:1630734004:0.text: Well, that's a living legend you're talking about.
say:3:1630734004:0.source_cn: 那位可是传奇的大魔法师

say:4:1630734005:0.text: Can't really blame them for losing their minds.
say:4:1630734005:0.source_cn: 不管有多受欢迎，都是正常的吧！
